bank_name.description: Name of the bank issuing the statement.

account_holder.description: Account holder's name as printed in the address block.

account_number.description: Account number of the deposit account, as printed.

account_type.description: Account product name, e.g. TRUE CHECKING.

activity_summary.description: The account activity summary, exactly as printed. Do not compute or correct the figures.

period_start_date.description: Date of the previous balance, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end_date.description: Date of the ending balance, as YYYY-MM-DD.

days_in_period.description: Number of days in the statement period.

deposits_total.description: Total deposits and credits, in dollars.

withdrawals_total.description: Total checks and withdrawals, in dollars.

transactions.description: Every row of the TRANSACTIONS table across all pages, in order, excluding the Previous Balance row.

description.description: Description as printed, joined into one line if it wraps.

debit.description: Amount in the Debits column, or null if empty.

credit.description: Amount in the Credits column, or null if empty.

balance.description: Running balance after the transaction, in dollars.

checks.description: Every check in the CHECKS section.

number.description: Check number, without any sequence-break asterisk.

date.description: Date the check cleared, as YYYY-MM-DD.

break_in_sequence.description: True if the check number is marked with an asterisk, indicating a break in sequence.

overdraft_line.description: The linked overdraft line of credit (e.g. Ready Reserve), if the statement includes one.

account_number.description: Account number of the credit line.

payment_due_date.description: Current payment due date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

annual_percentage_rate.description: Annual percentage rate, as a percentage, e.g. 18.0.
